prefix_prediction_match.scope: First two tasks only; no independent ten-task performance reference

accuracy.forgetting_definition: Mean over old tasks 1..9 of max accuracy after acquisition through task9 minus accuracy after task10; improvements remain negative.

resources.scope: Task interval starts before loading and ends after evaluation/prediction/checkpoint audit; per-task Slack/logging and final artifact upload are excluded. Phase times are inclusive; do not sum nested phases.
resources.energy_scope: Sampled power integral for the selected GPU board; CPU/RAM and total machine energy are unmeasured.
resources.memory_scope: CUDA allocator peak is reset per task; NVML device and summed process-tree RSS are sampled peaks. RSS can count shared fork pages more than once.
resources.missing_resource_values: null means unavailable; values are never imputed.

work_counts.scope: Counts come from saved outer-loop metrics, counts.prompt_training_tii_examples and alignment history. Additional TII forward image examples reuse the prompt-stage images in a second frozen encoder; they are neither additional outer-loop images nor unique images. A missing counter remains null. Generated synthetic features are a sampled population, not raw images or classifier-consumed training examples. Optimizer steps cover heterogeneous operations and do not estimate FLOPs or equal compute budgets.

limitations: Single seed1993; no seed variation estimate or confidence interval.
Native full10 run; matched independent implementation validation covers only the first two tasks.
The author-code protocol and IN21K→IN1K weights are explicit adaptations; this is not paper-table reproduction.
Abnormally low accuracy is an implementation issue to investigate; no paper threshold is applied across different recipes.
No equal-compute-budget comparison or new full10 FLOPs profiling was performed.
